evidencepack/access-posture@v1./sign_in/sso_configured: Reads the organization's samlIdentityProvider from GitHub's GraphQL API and is true when it is set.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./sign_in/scim_enabled: Reads the external identities of the organization's members and is true when any of them has a SCIM identity.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/members_present: Lists the organization's members and outside collaborators and is true when either list has anyone.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/member_count: Counts the organization's members and outside collaborators.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/external_members_present: Lists the organization's outside collaborators and is true when there are any.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/sso_member_count: Counts the organization's members whose external identity has a linked SAML identity.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/sso_coverage_pct: Divides sso_member_count by member_count and rounds down.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/local_members_present: Is true when the organization has any member or outside collaborator. Members linked to SAML count too, since whether SAML single sign-on is required is not available from GitHub's organization API.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/local_member_count: Counts the organization's members and outside collaborators. Members linked to SAML count too, since whether SAML single sign-on is required is not available from GitHub's organization API.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/local_mfa_member_count: Counts the members who are not on GitHub's list of members without two-factor authentication, and the outside collaborators who are not on its list of outside collaborators without it.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/local_mfa_coverage_pct: Divides local_mfa_member_count by local_member_count and rounds down.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./admins/admins_present: Lists the organization's owners and is true when there are any.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./admins/admin_share_pct: Divides admin_count by members.member_count and rounds up.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./admins/local_admins_present: Is true when the organization has any owner. Owners linked to SAML count too, since whether SAML single sign-on is required is not available from GitHub's organization API.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./admins/local_admin_count: Counts the organization's owners. Owners linked to SAML count too, since whether SAML single sign-on is required is not available from GitHub's organization API.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./admins/local_mfa_admin_count: Counts the owners who are not on GitHub's list of members without two-factor authentication.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./admins/local_admin_mfa_coverage_pct: Divides local_mfa_admin_count by local_admin_count and rounds down.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/credentials_present: Is true when the organization has approved any fine-grained personal access token or an in-scope repository has any deploy key.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/credential_count: Counts the fine-grained personal access tokens approved for the organization and the deploy keys of the in-scope repositories. Classic personal access tokens are not counted.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/never_expiring_credential_c: Counts the fine-grained tokens with no expiry date and every deploy key, since deploy keys never expire.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/never_expiring_pct: Divides never_expiring_credential_count by credential_count and rounds up.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/unused_credential_count: Counts the fine-grained tokens and deploy keys that were never used or were last used more than 90 days ago.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/unused_pct: Divides unused_credential_count by credential_count and rounds up.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/unrestricted_credential_cou: Counts none of the fine-grained tokens or deploy keys. A fine-grained token has only the permissions and repositories it was given, and a deploy key works on one repository.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/unrestricted_pct: Divides unrestricted_credential_count by credential_count and rounds up.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/write_access_credential_cou: Counts the fine-grained tokens with any write or admin permission and the deploy keys that are not read-only.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/write_access_pct: Divides write_access_credential_count by credential_count and rounds up.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/rotation_overdue_credential: Counts the deploy keys created more than 90 days ago. It is left out when the organization has approved any fine-grained token, since GitHub's token grants have no creation date.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/rotation_overdue_pct: Divides rotation_overdue_credential_count by credential_count and rounds up.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./connected_apps/apps_present: Lists the organization's GitHub App installations and is true when any of them is not suspended.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./connected_apps/app_count: Counts the organization's GitHub App installations that are not suspended, including the App the collector signs in as.

evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/enabled: Is true when at least one in-scope repository has the scanner turned on.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/open_critical_present: Lists the open alerts of each in-scope repository and is true when any is rated critical.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/open_high_present: Lists the open alerts of each in-scope repository and is true when any is rated high.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/overdue_present: Is true when an open alert rated critical was created more than 30 days ago, or one rated high more than 90 days ago.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/open_critical_count: Counts the open alerts rated critical. A Dependabot alert takes the severity of its vulnerability, and a code scanning alert the security severity of its rule.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/open_high_count: Counts the open alerts rated high. A Dependabot alert takes the severity of its vulnerability, and a code scanning alert the security severity of its rule.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/open_medium_count: Counts the open alerts rated medium. A Dependabot alert takes the severity of its vulnerability, and a code scanning alert the security severity of its rule.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/open_low_count: Counts the open alerts rated low. A Dependabot alert takes the severity of its vulnerability, and a code scanning alert the security severity of its rule.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/overdue_critical_count: Counts the open alerts rated critical that were created more than 30 days ago.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/overdue_high_count: Counts the open alerts rated high that were created more than 90 days ago.
